_: Robinhood Chain (4663) NFT collections that passed scripts/measure-robinhood-nfts.mjs (2026-10-11T23:09Z, 22.815 SOL/ETH). EthNft listings on chain 4663 on the books home; pinned after the ceremony once the 4663 evm_chains entry (Seaport 1.6's code hash) is read back. Floors and tiers in graduation-tiers.json. StonkBrokers is token-bound (ERC-6551 accounts holding tokenized stocks): priced and bought as the NFT only: audit C3-01, the canister refuses it unless eth_nft names its nft_value_bps (the share of a full account's price that is the bare NFT; every listing and sale is taken at that share), which the operator sets from sales of drained accounts before it is pinned, so none is written here; custodyItems / custodyWei are what the canister's stage 0 enforces for a 4663 collection (audit C3-08: FIRST_MAX_ITEMS items, each at most maxPurchaseWei); the custody of tokenized stocks is a legal question the operator has not resolved (docs: Risks).

collections.name: Wrapped StonkBrokers
collections._nftValue: Recommended 2026-10-12 from a sample of 16 accounts (#1 … #4444) read on chain: most hold ~0 ETH and nothing else; a few hold $3–233 of USDG; one holds 0.13 NVDA (Robinhood tokenized stock). Against a 1.47 ETH floor the contents are ~0–7 %, so the bare NFT is ~95 % of a full account's price. Set as eth_nft.collections[i].nft_value_bps = 9500 (audit C3-01). The account implementation (0xe946…7c4b) has no lock; the NFT is ERC-721C with NO transfer validator set today, but its owner (0x17e9…c66f) can set one at any time (setTransferValidator), which could block Rook's purchases or deliveries.
